# LegatorOCR v0.2.0-pre.15 (pre-release)

Changes since pre.14.

**Window (not tested by hand: there is no GUI test harness)**
- Undo / redo (↶ ↷) for the global settings, next to the per-sheet Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y that already existed.
- Orange marker and a reason on hover for sheets whose preview looks suspicious (blank result, skew at the limit, no content found, content touching the page edge), with a “N sheets to check” counter and a Next button. A heuristic on the preview, thresholds untuned.
- Welcome card when no page is loaded (3 steps, Add button).

**Command line**
- `--proof-sheet FILE.html` (with `--ocr`): an offline page with each scan beside an editable text box and a button that saves the corrected text. It is the tool for making a hand-checked reference text; nobody has produced one yet, so the OCR figures still rest on references made by the assistant.
- `--certify` now also compares mixed / hybrid (layered) pages, and with `--ocr` checks each page's text layer (words read back, boxes lying on blank paper).
- `--ocfl DIR [--ocfl-id ID]` and `--verify-ocfl DIR`: OCFL 1.1 object with a SHA-512 inventory. Cross-checked with `sha512sum` and a JSON parser; not run through an OCFL validator, and the checker reads only objects this program wrote.
- PDF bookmarks from `--bookmarks-headings` nest in two levels when heading sizes differ clearly; TEI output marks heading lines with `<head>`. Both rest on a heading detector that is still unmeasured.

Not solved: no hand-verified reference text; no real stamped scans; Windows / macOS builds are CI-only; package recipes unsubmitted.
